title: VTG 1996 Creative Con. MICHAEL JORDAN Trophy Bubble Gum Candy Container Bulls
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1996 Creative Confections Michael Jordan Trophy Bubble Gum Candy Container featuring the iconic Bulls player. The container is a unique collectible item that showcases Jordan's association with the Chicago Bulls during the 1990s. Made of brown color, this original piece from Jordan is a nostalgic piece of advertising and sports memorabilia that would appeal to fans of both Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls.
